#!/bin/bash
set -eu
sudo mkdir -p /run/sshd
if ! sudo test -f /etc/ssh/labex_host_ed25519; then sudo ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -f /etc/ssh/labex_host_ed25519; fi
sudo tee /etc/ssh/labex_sshd_config >/dev/null <<'CONFIG'
Port 22
ListenAddress 127.0.0.1
ListenAddress ::1
HostKey /etc/ssh/labex_host_ed25519
PidFile /run/labex-sshd.pid
PasswordAuthentication yes
PubkeyAuthentication yes
UsePAM no
PermitRootLogin no
LogLevel VERBOSE
Subsystem sftp internal-sftp
CONFIG
printf '%s\n' 'remoteuser:RemoteLab123!' | sudo chpasswd
sudo /usr/sbin/sshd -t -f /etc/ssh/labex_sshd_config
sudo /usr/sbin/sshd -f /etc/ssh/labex_sshd_config -E /var/log/labex/sshd.log
